adapter_disclosures: Input cited_evidence_ids maps to claim.source_ids; evidence text and candidate labels unchanged.
INSUFFICIENT maps to INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Missing references assessed as blocked before inference, not exact original status/verdict equality.
T20 intentionally injects an exception; it is not real model inference and is excluded from semantic scores.
No added temporal metadata, numeric calculators or source-quote rules. Source_id/finalized/source_quote are not enforced by Lite.
Only cited evidence is evaluated; uncited conflicting sources are outside Lite current contract.
All reports require human review; original expected review_required=false is not accepted as a product change.
Candidate labels are authored and unadjudicated; metrics do not prove generalization. Original benchmark remains unchanged.
Upstream evaluate_predictions.py was not used: it combines fault injection with invalid-input accounting and omits semantic mismatches from failed_case_ids.
